filters.predicate: role_id = rt_id_actress AND note IN voice_set AND person_role_id != INT32_MIN

join_order.notes: Driver = name pids with female + %An% AND aka_name presence. Use aka_name offsets to check non-empty range cheaply.
For each driver pid, scan ci rows; filter via precomputed ci_voice_bitset AND person_role_id != INT32_MIN.
Pre-walk movie_companies once; set bit[movie_id-1] if cn.country_code[company_id-1]==us. O(1) probe per ci row.
Walk aka_name rows for each surviving pid (lazily, only for pids that survive ci filter) to compute MIN(an.name).

data_structures.name_pid_bitset: bitset(4167491) — name pids with gender=f AND name LIKE '%An%'
data_structures.aka_name_presence_bitset: bitset(4167491) — pids with aka_name__person_id range non-empty
data_structures.driver_pid_list: compact vector<int32_t> from intersect(name_pid_bitset, aka_name_presence_bitset) — ~tens of thousands
data_structures.ci_voice_bitset: bitset(36244344) — ci rows with role_id=actress AND note IN voice_set AND person_role_id!=INT32_MIN (~276166 set)
data_structures.mc_movie_has_us_bitset: bitset(2528312) — movies with any mc row whose company is us
data_structures.min_accumulators: 4 string_view min accumulators (an_name, chn_name, n_name, t_title)

morsels.partition: movie_companies rows split across 12 threads, atomic-or into shared bitset (or thread-local then OR-merge)
driver pid list split across 12 threads; thread-local MIN accumulators merged at end

indexes.purpose: aka_name presence check AND per-pid an enumeration
